verdict: M183 is a correct standalone multiplier-free K8 signed-weight/Acc24 arithmetic island and a valid fixed-3ns absolute-latency DSE point. It does not supersede M169 K4: the M182 schedule is 1.307079853x faster than K4 but M183 is 1.459331866x larger, so same-clock analytic schedule throughput per logic area is only 0.895670055x K4. Keep K8 only as the latency Pareto point until a fixed-bank specialization, executable frontend, eight-bank weight response and post-PAFT numeric bridge close the missing costs.

P0.finding: The 97,607,807-cycle M182 result assumes bounded cross-descriptor fixed-bank scheduling, while M183 begins after a legal prefix-packed group and receives 6,144 weight bits for free. Producer, token directory, two-window lifetime, eight bank reads, response tags, stalls and any bank-to-prefix packing are absent.
P0.required_action: Compose the bounded D={2,4,8,8} K8 frontend with an explicit eight-bank weight-response shell and M183/fixed-bank successor, then replay exact payloads with stalls and conservation.

P0.finding: Every issue receives and returns an external 2,304-bit Acc24 context. Ownership, feedback hazards, final requantization, BN2 moment barrier and residual commit are excluded, so the module cannot establish complete-FC2 cycles.
P0.required_action: Implement a bounded context owner/writeback path and numeric miter through requant/BN2/residual before promoting a physical or FC2 claim.

P0.finding: The frozen ep35 M160 census proves twelve sn2 thresholds equal one, but the PAFT checkpoint and valid825 admission are not released. Observing any non-unit threshold in a broader checkpoint census is a warning, not a substitute for a sn2-specific census; any non-unit sn2 value breaks the direct event-times-INT8-weight identity.
P0.required_action: After PAFT release, hash the checkpoint, census all twelve sn2 thresholds, and either require exact one or generate an exact folded-weight quantization/multiplier contract plus valid825.

P1.finding: K8 reduces K4 schedule cycles by 23.493580% but increases logic-only cell area by 45.933187%, yielding 0.895670055x K4 throughput/area. K8 must fall below 24,210.885723 um2 to match K4 density at the frozen schedule ratio.
P1.required_action: Keep K4 as the density point and K8 as the latency point; perform a precommitted K5/K6/K7 schedule-plus-DC sweep or reduce K8 area by at least 10.432995% before claiming a strict replacement.

P1.finding: M182's natural interface is one selected source per fixed bank with an arbitrary eight-bit occupancy mask. M183 instead accepts prefix-packed arbitrary bank IDs, pays 28 pairwise uniqueness comparisons, and may force an external packing/routing network that is not in area or cycles.
P1.required_action: Build a fixed-bank successor accepting arbitrary bank-valid bits, with bank_mask=valid and no bank-ID uniqueness network; compare its DC area against the 24,210.885723-um2 density threshold.

P1.finding: The DC receipt labels 127,581,198 and 424,060,394 as M169/M170 wall cycles, but those schedule counts originate in the M179 finite-window scheduler model; M169/M170 arithmetic RTL has no scheduler or wall-cycle counter.
P1.required_action: Use M179-K4 and M179-K1 schedule lineage in all tables and overlays; describe the ratio as analytic schedule opportunity divided by matched arithmetic-island area.

P1.finding: The comparison uses ideal clock, ZeroWireload and zero macros. M183 has 11,625 port bits, 3,473 more than K4, and reports high-fanout timing approximation. No SRAM, routed interconnect, SAIF/PTPX, or frequency-normalized sweep is present.
P1.required_action: Add macro-aware bank models and routing, run SAIF/PTPX and a predeclared period sweep or pipeline comparison before any energy/FPS/physical claim.

P1.finding: RTL VCS and mapped DC pass, but RTL-to-netlist Formality is not part of the M183 receipt.
P1.required_action: Run exact-SHA Formality after the active queue is clear.

P2.finding: The M183 VCS contract states the ep35 sn2 threshold-one identity but omits M169's explicit M160 census source SHA. The review independently resolved the source to 7581ccfd..., so the fact is recoverable but not transitively pinned by the M183 runner.
P2.required_action: Add a correction overlay pinning the M160 census SHA and its twelve exact sn2 values.

P2.finding: The main random TB limits ordinary weights to approximately [-64,64] and combines non-prefix and duplicate-bank faults in one attack. The independent review miter closes -128/127, signed24 boundaries and separate attacks, but the canonical TB does not.
P2.required_action: Port the independent boundary cases into the canonical exact-SHA regression.

P2.finding: DC emits one VER-318 signed-to-unsigned part-selection warning at result truncation. Numeric behavior is independently correct, but the cast/waiver should be explicit.
P2.required_action: Use an explicit signed truncation cast or record a line-specific reviewed waiver.

P2.finding: SVA checks handshake, sticky faults, prefix/unique legality and stall stability, while popcount(source_count), bank-mask identity and accepted activity-mask equality are primarily TB checks.
P2.required_action: Add direct relational assertions for count, mask and activity identity.

recommended_next_milestone.name: fixed-bank K8 arithmetic and K4/K5/K6/K7/K8 Pareto closure
recommended_next_milestone.first_gate: fixed-bank K8 cell area <= 24210.885723 um2 under the exact M169/M183 3ns constraints, or explicitly retain K4 as the throughput-density point
recommended_next_milestone.interface: arbitrary bank_valid[7:0], fixed bank-to-weight lane, no bank IDs, no prefix requirement, direct bank_mask
recommended_next_milestone.mandatory_claim_wording: 4.344533568x is an exact-payload analytic K1/K8 bank-service boundary; 1.307079853x is the matched K4/K8 schedule ratio. Neither is physical, complete-FC2, system, or headline speedup.
